approach: Add an early-publish step in produce_and_verify, after admission and before the verifier snapshot/checks. `early_push` (gh.rs, generic over Remote, PrHost, Ancestry) pushes the candidate to the job's work branch only when the branch is missing, a fast-forward (check_push passes), or its head equals the recorded early-head marker (then a lease-pinned replace). Any other head: one warning, nothing pushed. It opens the PR if no link, stores link and marker, never merges. Errors become one `warning:` line. A trait `EarlyPush` is the seam; `go` calls `go_with_early(.., &GhEarly)` so signatures are unchanged. `GhEarly` returns silently without a GitHub origin; otherwise it builds GhCli/GhClient/GitRemote itself. Land runs `replace_early_head` (lease-pinned, marker-gated) before reading the remote head and sets link.head to L.

decisions.reason: Keeps go signature and CLI call sites unchanged; lets tests observe push/open_pr from inside go.

decisions.choice: early_push replaces a remote head only if it equals the pr-early-head marker (lease pinned to it); fast-forward or missing branch pushes normally; any other head gives one warning and no push, leaving link untouched so land still refuses.
decisions.reason: Answers finding 1: a foreign head must never be overwritten or laundered into link.head.

rejected.why: check_replace ignores ancestry, so it would overwrite someone else's fix and bypass land's refusal.

decisions.choice: Silent skip decided inside GhEarly (no origin or parse_remote fails). Test seam start_with(req, ui, runner, remote) takes both runner and Remote.
decisions.reason: Matches user decision; finding 3: case (c) must not touch the network, so it uses a FakeRemote and failing runner and asserts the warning text comes from the injected host error.

decisions.choice: Marker file pr-early-head in the job state dir (helpers in pr.rs); no new PrLink field.
decisions.reason: PrLink literals exist in non-deliverable files; marker also covers push-ok/open_pr-failed.

decisions.choice: Remote::replace with default bail; GitRemote uses push --force-with-lease=refs/heads/b:old. Production git calls in the early step (ls-remote, push) run with GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 so a credential prompt cannot stall go; GitRemote's git command builder gets that env (harmless for land). No extra timeout added beyond this and GhClient's bounded retries; stated as a known limit.
decisions.reason: Finding 5; L is not a descendant of C so plain push is refused.

decisions.reason: Finding 4: statements would otherwise be false.

demonstrations.method: Go-level test in run.rs runs go_with_early with a recording EarlyPush fake that calls early_push over fake Remote/PrHost; the fake remote, host and the scripted verifier/check fake all append to one shared event log.
demonstrations.observes: Log shows push(candidate to athena/<job>) and open_pr events before the first verifier/check event; open_pr count 1; merge count 0.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without the early call in produce_and_verify no push/open_pr events exist; if moved after the verdict the ordering assertion fails.

demonstrations.method: Run go three times: working fakes, failing Remote::push, failing PrHost::open_pr; compare final state/verdict.
demonstrations.observes: Outcome identical in all three; go returns Ok; failing runs print one warning line; landing proceeds.
demonstrations.fails_without: If early errors propagated, go would return Err or the job state would differ.

demonstrations.method: gh.rs tests with extended FakeRemote (replace, recorded list) and FakeHost (merge_heads): early_push with C then land_pr with L; second case early open_pr fails so land goes via publish; third case foreign head pushed before early_push: early_push warns and pushes nothing, land still refuses.
demonstrations.observes: One open_pr total; one lease-pinned replace (branch, L, expected C) after check_replace; link.head == L before head check; merge_heads == [L]; foreign head case: no replace, refusal.
demonstrations.fails_without: Without replace_early_head land sees head C != L and refuses (or publish check_push refuses non-fast-forward).

demonstrations.method: GhEarly::start with collecting Ui in a temp git repo: (a) no origin, (b) local-path origin; assert no 'warning' line and nothing pushed. (c) start_with using FakeRemote plus failing runner on a GitHub-shaped origin: exactly one warning whose text is the injected host error, no network. CLI lifecycle tests run unchanged.
demonstrations.observes: No warning in (a),(b); one injected-error warning in (c); lifecycle tests pass.
demonstrations.fails_without: If skips warned or errored, (a)/(b) and the lifecycle tests would show a warning line.

demonstrations.method: Run workspace tests, then cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets and cargo fmt --check; mutate-check each new test by removing the early call or replace_early_head.
demonstrations.observes: All pass clean; each new test fails under its mutation.
demonstrations.fails_without: Removing the early call or replace makes the criterion 1-3 tests fail.

demonstrations.observes: go signature unchanged; no diff under crates/athena-cli/src; GhCli built inside GhEarly.
States verification start opens/updates the job's PR so CI caches by fingerprint, never merges, missing/non-GitHub origin skipped quietly, failures non-fatal.
